mechanic.synopsis_text: 近现代的「青槐老城」，冬夜木楼电路老化起火，老城义务消防队第一时间抵达。 The setting is 青槐老城的「德昌号」杂货楼——门厅、走道、三间房与后院出口的砖木混合两层建筑。. 玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。 Core loop: 进入火场 → 控火开路 → 救出被困者 → 抵达出口 → 结算。. 伤亡超限/自身倒下/超时＝救援失败（判负文案按原因）；成功则 C03 呈现全员撤出、火势渐熄的老街夜景。 Narrative devices: 三名被困者各有身份与位置来源——修表匠老人困于里间工作台、杂货店员困于柜台后储物间、学徒少年困于阁楼楼梯口；倒塌物＝烧塌的梁架与货架；水箱＝背负式水罐。全部原创。. Art direction: 风格化写实夜景火场；主色＝炭黑（#1F1B18 系）＋火橙红（#E0562A 系）＋水雾青白（#9FB8C4 系）；材质以焦木、砖石、水渍反光为主；火光为唯一主光源方向。. Sound direction: 夜火中的老街——常驻热浪低鸣与远处警铃；音效语言为「火焰噼啪＋水雾嘶声＋呼救人声＋警报」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。. Asset tasks: 5 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 4 tpose, 4 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
mechanic.scoring_protocol: C2按canonical等级M冻结12项，各一个scored subcheck，端点等权。其他七列沿用原冻结断言；原core12和全量来源不变。引用上下文不增加分母。这是分级核心子集，不宣称完整需求覆盖；新attempt的静态存在与运行政策另行冻结。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; interact→左键按住; interact→E; interact→F; pause→Esc; restart→Enter) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G06: - G06 被困者状态机（本包冻结值）：每名被困者状态＝平静 calm → 呼救 calling（火格或烟雾格与其距离 ≤2 格时触发）→ 恐慌 panicked（自身 HP <30 或身处烟雾格）→ 昏迷 down（HP 归零）；昏迷后 10 秒内未被背起即计伤亡；呼救与恐慌伴随头顶图标（文字标签「呼救中/恐慌」）与呼救音效；任意状态均可被 E 背起；背至出口外＝获救 rescued；状态转移为单向（获救终态除外）。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。

context.W03: - W03 玩家身份与当前任务：玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。

context.F05:
- F05 事件反馈表（事件 → 表现 → 结束条件，全部为冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 喷射灭火 | 前方 2 格锥形水雾＋火格蒸汽白烟 | 水压嘶声（按住循环） | 松开或水量 0 |
| 火格熄灭 | 火焰收缩熄灭＋余烬灰烟 | 熄灭嘶声 | 完成 |
| 火势蔓延 | 新火格点燃闪光＋火星迸溅 | 木质爆裂声 | 点燃完成 |
| 烟雾扩格 | 烟雾体积推移＋视野边缘变灰 | 烟雾低鸣（烟雾区循环） | 离开或通风 |
| 破拆进行 | 倒塌物碎屑飞溅＋进度环 2 秒 | 锤击闷响×2 | 清除完成 |
| 坍塌预警 | 承重梁红闪＋「即将坍塌」图标 | 木裂预警音 | 预警期结束 |
| NPC 呼救 | 头顶「呼救中」图标＋挥手动画 | 呼救人声（calling 循环） | 状态变化 |
| NPC 恐慌 | 头顶「恐慌」图标＋瑟缩动画 | 急促呜咽声 | 状态变化 |
| NPC 昏迷 | 头顶「昏迷」图标＋倒地 | 呼救声停止 | 被背起或计伤亡 |
| 背起/放下 | 负重起身动作＋背负图标 | 用力闷哼 | 完成 |
| 获救 | 出口外居民转身示意＋计数 +1 | 获救确认音 | 常亮 |
| 受击 | 屏幕红闪＋HP 跳动＋小幅震动 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 路线阻断 | HUD 红色「路线阻断」提示＋最近倒塌物高亮 | 低频警报音 | 解除即消 |
| 全员撤离 | 出口横幅＋火场远景渐暗 | 撤离提示音 | 进入结算 |

- C01 开场灾情（Opening，10 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首次由任务简报进入火场之前，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：青槐老城冬夜，「德昌号」木楼窗口喷出火舌，义务消防队员提水罐冲入巷口，楼内传来呼救
  - 资产对应：老街、木楼、消防员与游戏内模型同源设计
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入建筑外整备位；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：播放期间不推进 300 秒倒计时；进入状态＝0/3 获救
context.C02:
- C02 首名获救（Event，6 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首个 `rescued` 事件后的下一帧短暂插入（每局一次）
  - 内容与角色场景：获救居民在出口外回头示意，队员抹去面罩水汽返身入楼，身后火光映在湿石板路
  - 资产对应：出口、后院、居民与游戏内一致
  - 可跳过：Esc 跳过 → 回到火场继续；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：仅在真实 rescued 后触发，返回时救援进度不变
context.C03:
- C03 全员撤离（Ending，10 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：3 名被困者全部获救并触发 V01 后、结算面板之前，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：三名居民与队员在后院出口回望渐熄的楼体，消防铃声转为平安钟，夜色恢复安静
  - 资产对应：老街、木楼、出口与游戏内一致
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入结算面板；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：仅在真实达成 V01 后触发
context.V01: - V01 成功条件：3 名被困者全部救出并随玩家抵达出口 → 结算（显示用时、剩余水量、伤亡数）。

| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G05: - G05 暂停与失焦：Esc 暂停冻结火势、烟雾、HP 与计时；窗口失焦自动暂停；UI 过渡不推进状态。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。
context.V02: - V02 失败条件：被困者伤亡达 2 人、玩家 HP 归零、或 300 秒超时 → 失败结算（注明原因）。
context.V06: - V06 软锁与不可达处理：不设永久软锁——路线阻断提示引导清理倒塌物或控火开路；玩家死亡/超时走 V02 判负路径而非无限等待。

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 喷射灭火 | 前方 2 格锥形水雾＋火格蒸汽白烟 | 水压嘶声（按住循环） | 松开或水量 0 |

| 坍塌预警 | 承重梁红闪＋「即将坍塌」图标 | 木裂预警音 | 预警期结束 |
| NPC 呼救 | 头顶「呼救中」图标＋挥手动画 | 呼救人声（calling 循环） | 状态变化 |
| NPC 恐慌 | 头顶「恐慌」图标＋瑟缩动画 | 急促呜咽声 | 状态变化 |
| NPC 昏迷 | 头顶「昏迷」图标＋倒地 | 呼救声停止 | 被背起或计伤亡 |
| 背起/放下 | 负重起身动作＋背负图标 | 用力闷哼 | 完成 |
| 获救 | 出口外居民转身示意＋计数 +1 | 获救确认音 | 常亮 |
| 受击 | 屏幕红闪＋HP 跳动＋小幅震动 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 路线阻断 | HUD 红色「路线阻断」提示＋最近倒塌物高亮 | 低频警报音 | 解除即消 |
| 全员撤离 | 出口横幅＋火场远景渐暗 | 撤离提示音 | 进入结算 |

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#G:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.

asset_slot.synopsis_text: 近现代的「青槐老城」，冬夜木楼电路老化起火，老城义务消防队第一时间抵达。 The setting is 青槐老城的「德昌号」杂货楼——门厅、走道、三间房与后院出口的砖木混合两层建筑。. 玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。 Core loop: 进入火场 → 控火开路 → 救出被困者 → 抵达出口 → 结算。. 伤亡超限/自身倒下/超时＝救援失败（判负文案按原因）；成功则 C03 呈现全员撤出、火势渐熄的老街夜景。 Narrative devices: 三名被困者各有身份与位置来源——修表匠老人困于里间工作台、杂货店员困于柜台后储物间、学徒少年困于阁楼楼梯口；倒塌物＝烧塌的梁架与货架；水箱＝背负式水罐。全部原创。. Art direction: 风格化写实夜景火场；主色＝炭黑（#1F1B18 系）＋火橙红（#E0562A 系）＋水雾青白（#9FB8C4 系）；材质以焦木、砖石、水渍反光为主；火光为唯一主光源方向。. Sound direction: 夜火中的老街——常驻热浪低鸣与远处警铃；音效语言为「火焰噼啪＋水雾嘶声＋呼救人声＋警报」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。. Asset tasks: 5 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 4 tpose, 4 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
asset_slot.scoring_protocol: 本版本机制 C2 固定十二项、项间等权，每项仅一个可计分判定；引用上下文不再展开为额外评分原子。未选中的 general_requirement 规则不属于本版本 C2 分母；其他维度保留原有验收项。这是核心机制子集协议，不宣称覆盖完整需求；与历史全量协议分开报告。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。子检查角色为 precondition/action/behavior/boundary/recovery。precondition/action 是取证门槛，不计功能完成分。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；任何必需子检查 UNKNOWN 或取证门槛 FAIL，主项 UNKNOWN。门槛全部通过后，仅按 behavior/boundary/recovery 的 PASS 数/冻结可计分子检查数计算；全通过 PASS、全失败 FAIL，其余 PARTIAL。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; interact→左键按住; interact→E; interact→F; pause→Esc; restart→Enter) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

selection.title: 离散火势传播（主机制）：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 火格每 4 秒向相邻可燃格蔓延（按 G03 规则与材质表）；烟雾由火格生成并向邻格扩散

selection.title: 离散火势传播（主机制）：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 不可燃材质格永不点燃

selection.title: 烟雾能见度与移动：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 能见度下降（视野半径受限）＋ HP 每秒 −2 ＋ 移速 ×0.7（G07）

selection.title: 烟雾能见度与移动：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 离开烟雾区即恢复

selection.title: 灭火资源：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 水量按 10 单位/秒消耗 → 命中火格累计 20 单位后熄灭；资源有限需取舍

selection.title: 灭火资源：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 水量 0 喷射无效

selection.title: 障碍清理与路线阻断：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 2 秒清除倒塌物 → 路径开通；每次火格/倒塌物变化后重算路线阻断并更新提示（G07）

selection.title: 被困者状态与救援：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: calm→calling→panicked→down 单向转移；背起 → 背负中（移速减半、禁喷射）；出口外放下 → rescued

selection.title: 暂停冻结与继续
selection.expectation: - G05 暂停与失焦：Esc 暂停冻结火势、烟雾、HP 与计时；窗口失焦自动暂停；UI 过渡不推进状态。

selection.title: 成功终局
selection.expectation: - V01 成功条件：3 名被困者全部救出并随玩家抵达出口 → 结算（显示用时、剩余水量、伤亡数）。

selection.title: 失败或非失败边界
selection.expectation: - V02 失败条件：被困者伤亡达 2 人、玩家 HP 归零、或 300 秒超时 → 失败结算（注明原因）。

subchecks.source_text:
- M01 离散火势传播（主机制）
  - input：系统计时（seed 驱动）

  - state_change：火格每 4 秒向相邻可燃格蔓延（按 G03 规则与材质表）；烟雾由火格生成并向邻格扩散

  - recovery：灭火（M03）改变集合

context.G03: - G03 火势传播（本包冻结值）：火格每 4 秒尝试向相邻格蔓延——邻格为木质则点燃、为水泥/金属则不燃；烟雾格由火格生成并向邻格缓慢扩散。状态转移 oracle：给定 seed=1047 的初始火格集合（单一木质火格），第 4 秒其相邻木质格必被点燃、水泥格不燃，火格集合随时间步唯一确定；任何偏离即 FAIL。水量守恒 oracle：喷射熄灭 5 个火格必耗 100 单位（20/格）。

context.G06: - G06 被困者状态机（本包冻结值）：每名被困者状态＝平静 calm → 呼救 calling（火格或烟雾格与其距离 ≤2 格时触发）→ 恐慌 panicked（自身 HP <30 或身处烟雾格）→ 昏迷 down（HP 归零）；昏迷后 10 秒内未被背起即计伤亡；呼救与恐慌伴随头顶图标（文字标签「呼救中/恐慌」）与呼救音效；任意状态均可被 E 背起；背至出口外＝获救 rescued；状态转移为单向（获救终态除外）。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。

context.C01:
- C01 开场灾情（Opening，10 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首次由任务简报进入火场之前，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：青槐老城冬夜，「德昌号」木楼窗口喷出火舌，义务消防队员提水罐冲入巷口，楼内传来呼救
  - 资产对应：老街、木楼、消防员与游戏内模型同源设计
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入建筑外整备位；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：播放期间不推进 300 秒倒计时；进入状态＝0/3 获救
context.C02:
- C02 首名获救（Event，6 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首个 `rescued` 事件后的下一帧短暂插入（每局一次）
  - 内容与角色场景：获救居民在出口外回头示意，队员抹去面罩水汽返身入楼，身后火光映在湿石板路
  - 资产对应：出口、后院、居民与游戏内一致
  - 可跳过：Esc 跳过 → 回到火场继续；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：仅在真实 rescued 后触发，返回时救援进度不变

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G05: - G05 暂停与失焦：Esc 暂停冻结火势、烟雾、HP 与计时；窗口失焦自动暂停；UI 过渡不推进状态。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。
context.V02: - V02 失败条件：被困者伤亡达 2 人、玩家 HP 归零、或 300 秒超时 → 失败结算（注明原因）。
context.V06: - V06 软锁与不可达处理：不设永久软锁——路线阻断提示引导清理倒塌物或控火开路；玩家死亡/超时走 V02 判负路径而非无限等待。

- F05 事件反馈表（事件 → 表现 → 结束条件，全部为冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 喷射灭火 | 前方 2 格锥形水雾＋火格蒸汽白烟 | 水压嘶声（按住循环） | 松开或水量 0 |
| 火格熄灭 | 火焰收缩熄灭＋余烬灰烟 | 熄灭嘶声 | 完成 |
| 火势蔓延 | 新火格点燃闪光＋火星迸溅 | 木质爆裂声 | 点燃完成 |
| 烟雾扩格 | 烟雾体积推移＋视野边缘变灰 | 烟雾低鸣（烟雾区循环） | 离开或通风 |
| 破拆进行 | 倒塌物碎屑飞溅＋进度环 2 秒 | 锤击闷响×2 | 清除完成 |
| 坍塌预警 | 承重梁红闪＋「即将坍塌」图标 | 木裂预警音 | 预警期结束 |
| NPC 呼救 | 头顶「呼救中」图标＋挥手动画 | 呼救人声（calling 循环） | 状态变化 |
| NPC 恐慌 | 头顶「恐慌」图标＋瑟缩动画 | 急促呜咽声 | 状态变化 |
| NPC 昏迷 | 头顶「昏迷」图标＋倒地 | 呼救声停止 | 被背起或计伤亡 |
| 背起/放下 | 负重起身动作＋背负图标 | 用力闷哼 | 完成 |
| 获救 | 出口外居民转身示意＋计数 +1 | 获救确认音 | 常亮 |
| 受击 | 屏幕红闪＋HP 跳动＋小幅震动 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 路线阻断 | HUD 红色「路线阻断」提示＋最近倒塌物高亮 | 低频警报音 | 解除即消 |
| 全员撤离 | 出口横幅＋火场远景渐暗 | 撤离提示音 | 进入结算 |

context.F06: - F06 关键音效清单：水压嘶声、熄灭嘶声、木质爆裂、锤击、木裂预警、呼救人声、呜咽、闷哼、确认音、受击、低频警报、撤离音；环境音：热浪低鸣＋警铃远响（常驻循环）；循环音开始/结束：呼救声按 NPC 状态起止、烟雾低鸣按区域起止、暂停全部静音；无配音台词（呼救为非语义人声效果）。
context.W07: - W07 环境氛围与声音语言：夜火中的老街——常驻热浪低鸣与远处警铃；音效语言为「火焰噼啪＋水雾嘶声＋呼救人声＋警报」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。

context.F07: - F07 VFX 信息性与遮挡约束：被困者状态图标与出口安全灯承担救援信息；坍塌预警红闪承担危险信息；烟雾体积不遮挡 HUD 与出口方向（出口绿灯穿透烟雾可见）；水雾粒子单帧 ≤ 50。
context.F10: - F10 前端界面：任务简报（被困人数/水量/限时/出警）→ HUD（HP、水量、剩余时间、已救人数/3、NPC 状态图标、路线阻断提示）→ 结算（用时/剩余水量/伤亡数/重开/返回）→ 判负（原因注明/重开）→ 暂停面板（继续/重开/设置）；关键状态附图标＋文字（呼救/恐慌/昏迷/阻断），不只靠颜色区分；窗口失焦自动暂停。

context.L01: - L01 生成对象：玩家消防员 1（人形）、被困者 3（原创造型：修表匠老人/杂货店员/学徒少年）、火格与烟雾格若干、倒塌物 4 处、出口 1；建筑装饰为表现层。
context.L02: - L02 建筑：单栋老城砖木混合建筑（约 20×16 格两层平面：门厅、走道、三间房、后院出口）；初始火格 3 处、可燃材质分布与被困者位置由 seed=1047 冻结。

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#G:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

assertions.partial_rule: 全部取证门槛通过且所有必需子检查均已判定，按可计分行为 PASS 数/冻结可计分行为数计分；任一 UNKNOWN 或门槛 FAIL 则整行 UNKNOWN。
assertions.fail_rule: 取证门槛通过，全部可计分行为均有实际反证；门槛未建立、未触发或缺证据不能判 FAIL。

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#CH:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

gameness.synopsis_text: 近现代的「青槐老城」，冬夜木楼电路老化起火，老城义务消防队第一时间抵达。 The setting is 青槐老城的「德昌号」杂货楼——门厅、走道、三间房与后院出口的砖木混合两层建筑。. 玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。 Core loop: 进入火场 → 控火开路 → 救出被困者 → 抵达出口 → 结算。. 伤亡超限/自身倒下/超时＝救援失败（判负文案按原因）；成功则 C03 呈现全员撤出、火势渐熄的老街夜景。 Narrative devices: 三名被困者各有身份与位置来源——修表匠老人困于里间工作台、杂货店员困于柜台后储物间、学徒少年困于阁楼楼梯口；倒塌物＝烧塌的梁架与货架；水箱＝背负式水罐。全部原创。. Art direction: 风格化写实夜景火场；主色＝炭黑（#1F1B18 系）＋火橙红（#E0562A 系）＋水雾青白（#9FB8C4 系）；材质以焦木、砖石、水渍反光为主；火光为唯一主光源方向。. Sound direction: 夜火中的老街——常驻热浪低鸣与远处警铃；音效语言为「火焰噼啪＋水雾嘶声＋呼救人声＋警报」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。. Asset tasks: 5 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 4 tpose, 4 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
gameness.scoring_protocol: 白模主评分配额 S30/M55/L-Regular80/L-Stress105；CH 诊断另列。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。子检查角色为 precondition/action/behavior/boundary/recovery。precondition/action 是取证门槛，不计功能完成分。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；任何必需子检查 UNKNOWN 或取证门槛 FAIL，主项 UNKNOWN。门槛全部通过后，仅按 behavior/boundary/recovery 的 PASS 数/冻结可计分子检查数计算；全通过 PASS、全失败 FAIL，其余 PARTIAL。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; interact→左键按住; interact→E; interact→F; pause→Esc; restart→Enter) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.G03: - G03 火势传播（本包冻结值）：火格每 4 秒尝试向相邻格蔓延——邻格为木质则点燃、为水泥/金属则不燃；烟雾格由火格生成并向邻格缓慢扩散。状态转移 oracle：给定 seed=1047 的初始火格集合（单一木质火格），第 4 秒其相邻木质格必被点燃、水泥格不燃，火格集合随时间步唯一确定；任何偏离即 FAIL。水量守恒 oracle：喷射熄灭 5 个火格必耗 100 单位（20/格）。

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。

context.G03: - G03 火势传播（本包冻结值）：火格每 4 秒尝试向相邻格蔓延——邻格为木质则点燃、为水泥/金属则不燃；烟雾格由火格生成并向邻格缓慢扩散。状态转移 oracle：给定 seed=1047 的初始火格集合（单一木质火格），第 4 秒其相邻木质格必被点燃、水泥格不燃，火格集合随时间步唯一确定；任何偏离即 FAIL。水量守恒 oracle：喷射熄灭 5 个火格必耗 100 单位（20/格）。

assertions.assertion: 火势蔓延与阻断 / 离散火势传播（主机制）
assertions.pass_rule: 已执行且本行所有冻结子检查均有充分证据通过。
assertions.partial_rule: 全部取证门槛通过且所有必需子检查均已判定，按可计分行为 PASS 数/冻结可计分行为数计分；任一 UNKNOWN 或门槛 FAIL 则整行 UNKNOWN。

context.G03: - G03 火势传播（本包冻结值）：火格每 4 秒尝试向相邻格蔓延——邻格为木质则点燃、为水泥/金属则不燃；烟雾格由火格生成并向邻格缓慢扩散。状态转移 oracle：给定 seed=1047 的初始火格集合（单一木质火格），第 4 秒其相邻木质格必被点燃、水泥格不燃，火格集合随时间步唯一确定；任何偏离即 FAIL。水量守恒 oracle：喷射熄灭 5 个火格必耗 100 单位（20/格）。
context.M01:
- M01 离散火势传播（主机制）
  - input：系统计时（seed 驱动）
  - precondition：处于游玩状态（非暂停/结算）
  - state_change：火格每 4 秒向相邻可燃格蔓延（按 G03 规则与材质表）；烟雾由火格生成并向邻格扩散
  - observable：火格点燃/熄灭事件与逐时间步火格集合快照（规则可复现）
  - invalid_case：不可燃材质格永不点燃
  - recovery：灭火（M03）改变集合
context.M03:
- M03 灭火资源
  - input：左键喷射
  - precondition：水量 >0
  - state_change：水量按 10 单位/秒消耗 → 命中火格累计 20 单位后熄灭；资源有限需取舍
  - observable：灭火事件与水量流水（守恒，见 G03 oracle）
  - invalid_case：水量 0 喷射无效
  - recovery：无补给（单局预算制）

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G06: - G06 被困者状态机（本包冻结值）：每名被困者状态＝平静 calm → 呼救 calling（火格或烟雾格与其距离 ≤2 格时触发）→ 恐慌 panicked（自身 HP <30 或身处烟雾格）→ 昏迷 down（HP 归零）；昏迷后 10 秒内未被背起即计伤亡；呼救与恐慌伴随头顶图标（文字标签「呼救中/恐慌」）与呼救音效；任意状态均可被 E 背起；背至出口外＝获救 rescued；状态转移为单向（获救终态除外）。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。

context.W03: - W03 玩家身份与当前任务：玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。

  - 内容与角色场景：青槐老城冬夜，「德昌号」木楼窗口喷出火舌，义务消防队员提水罐冲入巷口，楼内传来呼救
  - 资产对应：老街、木楼、消防员与游戏内模型同源设计
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入建筑外整备位；自然播完 → 同
  - 状态一致：播放期间不推进 300 秒倒计时；进入状态＝0/3 获救
context.C02:
- C02 首名获救（Event，6 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首个 `rescued` 事件后的下一帧短暂插入（每局一次）
  - 内容与角色场景：获救居民在出口外回头示意，队员抹去面罩水汽返身入楼，身后火光映在湿石板路
  - 资产对应：出口、后院、居民与游戏内一致
  - 可跳过：Esc 跳过 → 回到火场继续；自然播完 → 同

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.G02: - G02 数值（本包冻结值）：玩家 HP 100；接触火格每秒 −10、烟雾区每秒 −2、安全区每秒 +1（上限 100）；被困者 3 名各有 HP 50（接触火格每秒 −10）；伤亡上限 1 人（第 2 人伤亡即判负）；水箱 100 单位、每秒喷射 10 单位、每熄灭一火格耗 20 单位；破拆倒塌物耗时 2 秒。
context.G04: - G04 seed 与计时：fixed_seed=1047 冻结初始火格、可燃材质分布、被困者位置与烟雾扩散；单局限时 **300 秒**（超时判负）。
context.G05: - G05 暂停与失焦：Esc 暂停冻结火势、烟雾、HP 与计时；窗口失焦自动暂停；UI 过渡不推进状态。
context.G07: - G07 烟雾移速与路线阻断（本包冻结值）：玩家处于烟雾格时移速 ×0.7（叠加背人减半时取乘积 ×0.35）；路线阻断判定——系统每次火格/倒塌物变化后计算每名未获救被困者到出口的通路，若全部通路被「火格＋未清除倒塌物」封锁，则 HUD 高亮提示「路线阻断」并指示最近可清理倒塌物（不自动开路）；判负条件不变（G02/G04）。
context.V02: - V02 失败条件：被困者伤亡达 2 人、玩家 HP 归零、或 300 秒超时 → 失败结算（注明原因）。
context.V06: - V06 软锁与不可达处理：不设永久软锁——路线阻断提示引导清理倒塌物或控火开路；玩家死亡/超时走 V02 判负路径而非无限等待。

| 坍塌预警 | 承重梁红闪＋「即将坍塌」图标 | 木裂预警音 | 预警期结束 |

| 受击 | 屏幕红闪＋HP 跳动＋小幅震动 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 路线阻断 | HUD 红色「路线阻断」提示＋最近倒塌物高亮 | 低频警报音 | 解除即消 |
| 全员撤离 | 出口横幅＋火场远景渐暗 | 撤离提示音 | 进入结算 |

context.F07: - F07 VFX 信息性与遮挡约束：被困者状态图标与出口安全灯承担救援信息；坍塌预警红闪承担危险信息；烟雾体积不遮挡 HUD 与出口方向（出口绿灯穿透烟雾可见）；水雾粒子单帧 ≤ 50。
context.F10: - F10 前端界面：任务简报（被困人数/水量/限时/出警）→ HUD（HP、水量、剩余时间、已救人数/3、NPC 状态图标、路线阻断提示）→ 结算（用时/剩余水量/伤亡数/重开/返回）→ 判负（原因注明/重开）→ 暂停面板（继续/重开/设置）；关键状态附图标＋文字（呼救/恐慌/昏迷/阻断），不只靠颜色区分；窗口失焦自动暂停。
context.I06: - I06 UI 必须显示的状态：HP、水量、剩余时间、已救人数/3、被困者状态图标（呼救/恐慌/昏迷）、路线阻断提示；HUD 对照见 rubric。
context.L01: - L01 生成对象：玩家消防员 1（人形）、被困者 3（原创造型：修表匠老人/杂货店员/学徒少年）、火格与烟雾格若干、倒塌物 4 处、出口 1；建筑装饰为表现层。
context.L02: - L02 建筑：单栋老城砖木混合建筑（约 20×16 格两层平面：门厅、走道、三间房、后院出口）；初始火格 3 处、可燃材质分布与被困者位置由 seed=1047 冻结。
context.L03: - L03 目标物/交互物/场景/UI 对象：本 spec §3–§9 引用的界面元素（任务简报/HUD/结算/判负/暂停/视频播放层）与交互物逐类存在且运行时可进入；数量与属性以 L01/L02 与 G 系为准。

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#G:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

general:L169-169.quote: - W01 世界与时代背景：近现代的「青槐老城」，冬夜木楼电路老化起火，老城义务消防队第一时间抵达。

general:L169-169.quote: - W01 世界与时代背景：近现代的「青槐老城」，冬夜木楼电路老化起火，老城义务消防队第一时间抵达。

general:L170-170.quote: - W02 场景所在地：青槐老城的「德昌号」杂货楼——门厅、走道、三间房与后院出口的砖木混合两层建筑。

general:L171-171.quote: - W03 玩家身份与当前任务：玩家是义务消防队队员；当前任务：控火、破拆、救出楼内 3 名被困居民并全员撤至后院出口。

general:L173-173.quote: - W05 叙事来源：三名被困者各有身份与位置来源——修表匠老人困于里间工作台、杂货店员困于柜台后储物间、学徒少年困于阁楼楼梯口；倒塌物＝烧塌的梁架与货架；水箱＝背负式水罐。全部原创。

general:L174-174.quote: - W06 视觉风格与色彩材质：风格化写实夜景火场；主色＝炭黑（#1F1B18 系）＋火橙红（#E0562A 系）＋水雾青白（#9FB8C4 系）；材质以焦木、砖石、水渍反光为主；火光为唯一主光源方向。

general:L175-175.quote: - W07 环境氛围与声音语言：夜火中的老街——常驻热浪低鸣与远处警铃；音效语言为「火焰噼啪＋水雾嘶声＋呼救人声＋警报」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。

general:L110-110.quote: - L02 建筑：单栋老城砖木混合建筑（约 20×16 格两层平面：门厅、走道、三间房、后院出口）；初始火格 3 处、可燃材质分布与被困者位置由 seed=1047 冻结。

quality_protocol.quote:
资产自身质量使用下文各资产的两个质量子项。每项由固定评审器按 1–5 分锚点评价：
`1=严重缺陷，2=明显缺陷，3=基本可接受，4=轻微缺陷，5=无明显缺陷`，
以 `25 × (rating - 1)` 转为 0–100，然后等权平均。质量锚点须针对资产类型细化。
本轮全部语义判定由固定多模态评审模型完成，标为 **Judge Rating**；不使用 human scoring 或人工回退，也不标为 MOS。
传统/确定性指标单独输出原始值，不与 Rubric rating 相加。
